properties.statement: Lexical retrieval runs with no model, no model loading and no semantic state
properties.note: Keyword mode is run against a closed sqlite3 connection, so any semantic-state read would raise.

properties.statement: Both lanes rank only the same frozen frontier: lexical ProjectedFrontier workspace, checksum, recomputed contract checksum and ordered membership are verified, and the lexical lane is ranked internally by rank_projected
Internal modes keyword/semantic/combined with typed lane outcomes ok/no_match/unavailable(reason) and overall complete/partial/unavailable
Semantic mode never returns lexical hits as semantic success

Combined mode returns the exact keyword-mode lexical result with status partial for each known semantic unavailability: no_active_generation, stale_generation, incompatible_profile, incompatible_execution (query-side and recorded), incomplete_coverage, corrupt_state, query_not_embedded
A missing vector for an otherwise active generation is incomplete coverage (IncompleteSemanticCoverage), distinct from no generation
Empty query or empty authorized frontier gives deterministic no_match for every requested lane without reading semantic state
Unexpected errors are not hidden as unavailability (malformed query vector, storage error, unknown mode)
Exact exhaustive scoring over the complete authorized semantic frontier before retention; no frontier-size cap; per-lane hard maximum 200; final result limit default 10, hard maximum 50
properties.note: Exactness shown at 300 members (above the 200 budget). Not a scale or latency qualification.

properties.statement: rrf.v1: one-based ranks, k=60, absent lanes contribute zero, duplicates and gapped ranks refused, ties broken by UTF-8 evidence id
A zero semantic score is a real score: kept, ranked and reported
Occurrence-level provenance: the stored occurrence input_digest reaches ProjectedSemanticCandidate, SemanticHit and FusedHit.semantic_input_digest without exposing vector bytes
The internal result carries policy digest and authorization frontier checksum; generation/profile digests are None when the semantic lane resolved no generation
Hidden/excluded evidence never reaches either lane; semantic exclusion is exercised directly and lexical ranking is structurally limited to the projected authorized frontier
properties.note: The fixture directly proves semantic exclusion. This slice does not rerun the full add/remove rare-term and long-text BM25 statistics matrix.
